queries.text: Is the central object round or ball-shaped in outline?
Does the central object look like a solid three-dimensional ball rather than a flat surface?
Is the central object a fairly uniform, solid color across its whole surface?
Is the central object a flat, thin, leaf-like shape?
Does the object have a pointed tip or an elongated, tapering leaf outline?
Is most of the crop plain background such as sky, bare soil, ground, bark, or dead debris?
Is there one clearly dominant object centered in the crop rather than many small mixed elements?
Is the crop blurry or cluttered so that no single object is clearly identifiable?
